topic: Cleaning staging table for session data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the correct procedure and syntax for clearing stale session data from staging tables. Initially, [p1] asked about deleting data from `device_session_agg_ml_staging` and whether subsequent re-aggregation was needed.

[me] corrected the deletion command, noting that the initial attempt used an incorrect table name/syntax. The correct procedure involves cleaning the sharded version of the staging table (`device_session_agg_ml_staging_sharded`) across all nodes in the cluster.

After encountering syntax errors with standard cluster commands, [me] provided a workaround using `ALTER TABLE ... ON CLUSTER ... DELETE WHERE...` which is planned for an upgrade. It was confirmed that only cleaning the sharded staging table (`device_session_agg_ml_staging_sharded`) is necessary, as the main table (`device_session_agg_ml_staging`) is a logical view of these shards.
decisions: The stale session data must be cleared from `device_session_agg_ml_staging_sharded` across all cluster nodes.
action_items: Use the ALTER TABLE syntax for deleting data on the cluster until a proper syntactic sugar feature is implemented.
